fact_text: The analyst's EMA setup uses a 9-period and a 21-period exponential moving average on the same chart.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Exponential Moving Average (EMA) Trading Strategy | Stock Analysis for PSX and Equity Markets' (YouTube, 2025-01-26)

fact_text: When the 9-period EMA crosses above the 21-period EMA, the analyst treats it as an upside signal.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Exponential Moving Average (EMA) Trading Strategy | Stock Analysis for PSX and Equity Markets' (YouTube, 2025-01-26)

fact_text: When the 9-period EMA crosses below the 21-period EMA, the analyst treats it as a downside signal.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Exponential Moving Average (EMA) Trading Strategy | Stock Analysis for PSX and Equity Markets' (YouTube, 2025-01-26)

fact_text: In the analyst's method the stop-loss sits below the prior swing low, and targets are set at 1:1 and 1:2 reward-to-risk ratios.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Exponential Moving Average (EMA) Trading Strategy | Stock Analysis for PSX and Equity Markets' (YouTube, 2025-01-26)

fact_text: The analyst moved from the daily chart to the one-hour chart to apply the crossover method to shorter-term moves.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Exponential Moving Average (EMA) Trading Strategy | Stock Analysis for PSX and Equity Markets' (YouTube, 2025-01-26)

fact_text: On Sui Northern Gas's one-hour chart, bullish and bearish crossovers were followed by upward and downward moves, according to the analyst.
